_why: Names that mean nothing to a reader outside this workspace, and must not reach a repository the public can read. Checked by scripts/check-naming.mjs on every pipeline. A rule is data, not code: add one here rather than editing the script. Escape hatch, per line: naming-gate:allow <rule-id> - <reason>.

rules.message: An unannounced product name. Say what the thing is: "an OpenRS discovery front end", "the discovery UI" - which is what the code already calls it in VITE_DISCOVERY_ACTIVE and isDiscoveryActive.
A section number from a planning document that lives in the workspace and ships to nobody. Say what it means - in every case measured here, the sentence around it already did.
rules._exclude_why: The .graphqls files are copied from dcb-service and re-taken whenever that contract moves. Editing their comments here is drift that the next copy silently reverts; the fix belongs upstream.

rules.message: A workspace planning document. It is not in this repository and never will be, so a reader cannot follow the pointer. Put the argument in docs/ or the commit message.
rules._measured: Zero matches when this rule was added on 2026-09-24. It is here because the workspace plans are where the other two rules’ names come from, so this is the path by which the next one arrives.
